passages.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.
passages.sermon:
My soul, bless the LORD.
The LORD is my God.
God is very great.
God wears splendor.
God wears majesty.
passages.original: בָּרֲכִ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶת־ יְה֫וָ֥ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי גָּדַ֣לְתָּ מְּאֹ֑ד ה֭וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר לָבָֽשְׁתָּ׃

passages.text: He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent, laying the beams of His chambers in the waters above, making the clouds His chariot, walking on the wings of the wind.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD is very great.
The LORD wears light like a garment.
The LORD stretches out the heavens like a tent.
The LORD builds His upper rooms in the waters above.
The LORD makes the clouds His chariot.
The LORD walks on the wings of the wind.
passages.original: עֹֽטֶה־ א֭וֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָ֑ה נוֹטֶ֥ה שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם כַּיְרִיעָֽה׃ הַ֥מְקָרֶֽה בַמַּ֗יִם עֲ‍ֽלִיּ֫וֹתָ֥יו הַשָּׂם־ עָבִ֥ים רְכוּב֑וֹ הַֽ֝מְהַלֵּ֗ךְ עַל־ כַּנְפֵי־ רֽוּחַ׃

passages.text: He makes the winds His messengers, flames of fire His servants.
passages.sermon:
God acts with great power.
God makes the winds His messengers.
God commands the winds to carry His messages.
God makes flames of fire His servants.
God uses fire to serve His purposes.
passages.original: עֹשֶׂ֣ה מַלְאָכָ֣יו רוּח֑וֹת מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו אֵ֣שׁ לֹהֵֽט׃

passages.text: He set the earth on its foundations, never to be moved.
passages.sermon:
God created the earth.
God placed the earth on strong foundations.
The earth will not be moved.
The earth will remain secure forever.
passages.original: יָֽסַד־ אֶ֭רֶץ עַל־ מְכוֹנֶ֑יהָ בַּל־ תִּ֝מּ֗וֹט עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

passages.text: You covered it with the deep like a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
passages.sermon: God covered the earth with the deep.\r\nHe covered it like a garment.\r\nThe waters stood above the mountains.
passages.original: תְּ֭הוֹם כַּלְּב֣וּשׁ כִּסִּית֑וֹ עַל־ הָ֝רִ֗ים יַֽעַמְדוּ־ מָֽיִם׃

passages.text: At Your rebuke the waters fled; at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away— the mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place You assigned for them— You set a boundary they cannot cross, that they may never again cover the earth.
passages.sermon:
God created the earth.
God has power over all creation.
God spoke with authority.
At God's rebuke, the waters fled.
At the sound of God's thunder, the waters hurried away.
The mountains rose up.
The valleys sank down.
Each went to the place God assigned for them.
God set a boundary for the waters.
The waters cannot cross this boundary.
The waters will never again cover the earth.
passages.original: מִן־ גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְנוּס֑וּן מִן־ ק֥וֹל רַֽ֝עַמְךָ֗ יֵחָפֵזֽוּן׃ יַעֲל֣וּ הָ֭רִים יֵרְד֣וּ בְקָע֑וֹת אֶל־ מְ֝ק֗וֹם זֶ֤ה׀ יָסַ֬דְתָּ לָהֶֽם׃ גְּֽבוּל־ שַׂ֭מְתָּ בַּל־ יַֽעֲבֹר֑וּן בַּל־ יְ֝שׁוּב֗וּן לְכַסּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: He sends forth springs in the valleys; they flow between the mountains.
passages.sermon: God sends out springs.\r\nThe springs flow in the valleys.\r\nThe springs move between the mountains.
passages.original: הַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ מַ֭עְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִ֑ים בֵּ֥ין הָ֝רִ֗ים יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃

passages.text: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
passages.sermon: God gives water to every animal in the field.\r\nThe wild donkeys drink and satisfy their thirst.
passages.original: יַ֭שְׁקוּ כָּל־ חַיְת֣וֹ שָׂדָ֑י יִשְׁבְּר֖וּ פְרָאִ֣ים צְמָאָֽם׃

passages.text: The birds of the air nest beside the springs; they sing among the branches.
passages.sermon:
God sends springs into the valleys.
The springs flow between the mountains.
The birds of the air live beside these springs.
The birds build their nests there.
The birds sing among the branches.
passages.original: עֲ֭לֵיהֶם עוֹף־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׁכּ֑וֹן מִבֵּ֥ין עֳ֝פָאיִ֗ם יִתְּנוּ־ קֽוֹל׃

passages.text: He waters the mountains from His chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.
passages.sermon:
God acts as the provider.
God sends water from His heavenly chambers.
God waters the mountains.
God’s works produce fruit.
The earth receives the fruit of God’s works.
The earth becomes satisfied.
passages.original: מַשְׁקֶ֣ה הָ֭רִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָ֑יו מִפְּרִ֥י מַ֝עֲשֶׂ֗יךָ תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate, bringing forth food from the earth: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face to shine, and bread that sustains his heart.
passages.sermon:
God acts as the provider for all creation.
God makes grass grow for the livestock.
God causes plants to grow for people to work and cultivate.
God brings food out of the earth.
God gives wine that makes people’s hearts glad.
God gives oil that makes faces shine.
God gives bread that strengthens and sustains people’s hearts.
passages.original: מַצְמִ֤יחַ חָצִ֨יר׀ לַבְּהֵמָ֗ה וְ֭עֵשֶׂב לַעֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאָדָ֑ם לְה֥וֹצִיא לֶ֝֗חֶם מִן־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ וְיַ֤יִן׀ יְשַׂמַּ֬ח לְֽבַב־ אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְהַצְהִ֣יל פָּנִ֣ים מִשָּׁ֑מֶן וְ֝לֶ֗חֶם לְֽבַב־ אֱנ֥וֹשׁ יִסְעָֽד׃

passages.text: The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted, where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
passages.sermon:
The LORD fills His trees with abundance.
He planted the cedars of Lebanon.
The birds build their nests in these trees.
The stork makes her home in the cypresses.
passages.original: יִ֭שְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אַֽרְזֵ֥י לְ֝בָנ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָטָֽע׃ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֭ם צִפֳּרִ֣ים יְקַנֵּ֑נוּ חֲ֝סִידָ֗ה בְּרוֹשִׁ֥ים בֵּיתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: The high mountains are for the wild goats, the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers.
passages.sermon:
God made the high mountains.
The wild goats live on the high mountains.
God made the cliffs.
The rock badgers find safety in the cliffs.
passages.original: הָרִ֣ים הַ֭גְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִ֑ים סְ֝לָעִ֗ים מַחְסֶ֥ה לַֽשְׁפַנִּֽים׃

passages.text: He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.
passages.sermon:
God made the moon.
The moon marks the seasons.
God made the sun.
The sun knows when to set.
passages.original: עָשָׂ֣ה יָ֭רֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִ֑ים שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ יָדַ֥ע מְבוֹאֽוֹ׃

passages.text: You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
passages.sermon:
God brings darkness.
Night comes.
All the wild animals in the forest move about.
The beasts prowl during the night.
passages.original: תָּֽשֶׁת־ חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וִ֣יהִי לָ֑יְלָה בּֽוֹ־ תִ֝רְמֹ֗שׂ כָּל־ חַיְתוֹ־ יָֽעַר׃

passages.text: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
passages.sermon:
Young lions roar.
They want to catch prey.
They look for food.
They ask God for their food.
passages.original: הַ֭כְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִ֣ים לַטָּ֑רֶף וּלְבַקֵּ֖שׁ מֵאֵ֣ל אָכְלָֽם׃

passages.text: The sun rises, and they withdraw; they lie down in their dens.
passages.sermon:
God created the animals of the forest.
The sun rises.
The animals withdraw.
They go to their dens.
They lie down in their dens.
passages.original: תִּזְרַ֣ח הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפ֑וּן וְאֶל־ מְ֝עוֹנֹתָ֗ם יִרְבָּצֽוּן׃

passages.text: Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening.
passages.sermon:
Man leaves his home in the morning.
He goes out to do his work.
He labors throughout the day.
He continues his work until evening.
passages.original: יֵצֵ֣א אָדָ֣ם לְפָעֳל֑וֹ וְֽלַעֲבֹ֖דָת֣וֹ עֲדֵי־ עָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
passages.sermon: The LORD made many works.\r\nThe LORD made all His works with wisdom.\r\nThe earth is full of the LORD’s creatures.
passages.original: מָֽה־ רַבּ֬וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֨יךָ׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה כֻּ֭לָּם בְּחָכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ מָלְאָ֥ה הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ קִנְיָנֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.
passages.sermon:
The sea is here.
The sea is vast.
The sea is wide.
Many creatures live in the sea.
No one can count all the creatures in the sea.
Small living things are in the sea.
Great living things are also in the sea.
passages.original: זֶ֤ה׀ הַיָּ֥ם גָּדוֹל֮ וּרְחַ֪ב יָ֫דָ֥יִם שָֽׁם־ רֶ֭מֶשׂ וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר חַיּ֥וֹת קְ֝טַנּ֗וֹת עִם־ גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃

passages.text: There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
passages.sermon:
God made the sea.
The sea is large and wide.
Ships travel on the sea.
God created Leviathan.
Leviathan lives in the sea.
Leviathan plays in the sea.
passages.original: שָׁ֭ם אֳנִיּ֣וֹת יְהַלֵּכ֑וּן לִ֝וְיָתָ֗ן זֶֽה־ יָצַ֥רְתָּ לְשַֽׂחֶק־ בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.
passages.sermon:
God made the sea.
The sea is vast and wide.
Many creatures live in the sea.
Some creatures are great.
Some creatures are small.
All creatures depend on God.
All creatures look to God.
God gives food to every creature.
God gives food at the right time.
passages.original: כֻּ֭לָּם אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּר֑וּן לָתֵ֖ת אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
passages.sermon:
God gives food to all creatures.
The creatures gather the food God gives.
God opens His hand.
The creatures receive good things from God.
The creatures are satisfied.
passages.original: תִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם יִלְקֹט֑וּן תִּפְתַּ֥ח יָֽ֝דְךָ֗ יִשְׂבְּע֥וּן טֽוֹב׃

passages.text: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
passages.sermon:
God rules over all creatures.
God provides life to every living being.
When God hides His face, all creatures feel fear.
When God takes away their breath, they die.
They return to dust.
passages.original: תַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנֶיךָ֮ יִֽבָּהֵ֫ל֥וּן תֹּסֵ֣ף ר֭וּחָם יִגְוָע֑וּן וְֽאֶל־ עֲפָרָ֥ם יְשׁוּבֽוּן׃

passages.text: When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.
passages.sermon: God sends His Spirit.\r\nGod creates living beings.\r\nGod renews the earth.
passages.original: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח ר֭וּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵא֑וּן וּ֝תְחַדֵּ֗שׁ פְּנֵ֣י אֲדָמָֽה׃

passages.text: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is glorious.
His glory lasts forever.
The LORD creates all things.
He rejoices in His works.
passages.original: יְהִ֤י כְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֣ה לְעוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂמַ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה בְּמַעֲשָֽׂיו׃

passages.text: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful and holy.
He looks at the earth.
The earth trembles.
He touches the mountains.
The mountains begin to smoke.
passages.original: הַמַּבִּ֣יט לָ֭אָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָ֑ד יִגַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃

passages.text: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
passages.sermon:
I will sing to the LORD.
I will do this all my life.
I will sing praise to my God.
I will praise Him as long as I live.
passages.original: אָשִׁ֣ירָה לַיהוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי׃

passages.text: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
I rejoice in the LORD.
I want my thoughts to please Him.
I want my words to please Him.
I find joy in the LORD.
passages.original: יֶעֱרַ֣ב עָלָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י אָ֝נֹכִ֗י אֶשְׂמַ֥ח בַּיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah!
passages.sermon:
Sinners must disappear from the earth.
The wicked must not remain.
My soul, bless the LORD.
Praise the LORD.
passages.original: יִתַּ֤מּוּ חַטָּאִ֨ים׀ מִן־ הָאָ֡רֶץ וּרְשָׁעִ֤ים׀ ע֤וֹד אֵינָ֗ם בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־ יְהוָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
